description: EIA Scoping for - Construction of a new residential-led mixed use development, comprising four primary blocks (Blocks A & D) as well as a stand-alone cinema block. Blocks A & D will provide retail/restaurant space at the ground floor with residential apartments above. The majority of the blocks will vary in height from 4 to 13 storeys with a tower building in Block B (to the north of the site) rising to approximately 27 storeys. The Proposed Development will comprise:- Approximately 525 residential units; - Approximately 3,800 square metres (m2) of retail space (A1); - Approximately 2,600m2 of restaurant space (A3); and -Approximately 1,300m2 of cinema space (D2).The two basement levels will provide approximately 260 spaces, including 160 for the residents of the Proposed Development and the re-provision of 100 spaces for the Blenheim Centre car parking. The basement will also house the energy centre for the Proposed Development.
